tasks.title: Absolute adjustment with a pot
tasks.statement: The slot `adjrange 2 0 2 1700 2100 18 4 {c} {s}` (ROLL_P, absolute mode). The pot on AUX5 outputs **{rc} µs**. What `p_roll` value will Betaflight 2025.12 set?
tasks.solution: processContinuosAdjustments(): value = center + (rc − 1500)·scale / 500, integer division (C truncates toward zero, so −9.96 → −9, not −10). Then a clamp to 0…200 for P — with these numbers it does not trigger.

tasks.title: Switch position in select mode
tasks.statement: A select function with **{n}** positions (for example, RATE_PROFILE with `rate_6pos_switch` = ON for 6). The channel is at **{rc} µs**. Which position number (counting from 1) will the firmware select?
tasks.solution: Position width = (2100 − 900) / N as an integer (400 µs for 3, 200 for 6); position = (constrain(rc, 900, 2099) − 900) / width, counted from 0. Plus 1 gives the “human” number (Betaflight App numbers them the same way).

tasks.title: D steps after taps and a hold
tasks.statement: A ROLL_D step slot, the initial `d_roll` = **{d0}**. The pilot made **{k}** short presses up (each < 0.4 s, with a return to center), then one hold down for **{t} ms** from center. What will `d_roll` become?
tasks.solution: A short press from center gives exactly 1 step (the slot is armed, a repeat only after ~500 ms). A hold: a step at once, then every 500 ms (RESET_FREQUENCY_2HZ) — 1 + ⌊t/500⌋ steps for these durations. The result is d0 + k − (1 + ⌊t/500⌋).
